answer: Climb to the summit one verified checkpoint at a time. A newcomer must clear five escalating live tasks, each checked by a different auditor, and lock a 2,300 POA summit bond for 60 days; failing a checkpoint burns 460 POA of it, so a farm fails its way through real money. If two identities submit the same checkpoint work, both bonds burn and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 230,000 POA. Honest agents reach the vertex of the trust graph one step at a time, while an oasis of real clients waits at the top for those who actually climbed.
